# Society of Natural Capital Accounting (SoNCA)

> The Society of Natural Capital Accounting (SoNCA) is a not-for-profit professional association for people who produce, use and improve natural capital accounts. It connects practitioners across government, business, research and civil society; supports professional development; and advances credible methods and standards grounded in the UN System of Environmental-Economic Accounting (SEEA). Incorporated as an association in the Australian Capital Territory on 10 August 2026 (Association No. A06752); members worldwide.
